question: Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?
sql:
WITH order_pizzas AS (
    SELECT 
        c.order_id,
        c.pizza_id,
        c.extras,
        n.pizza_name
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders c
    JOIN pizza_names n ON c.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
    WHERE n.pizza_name IN ('Meatlovers', 'Vegetarian')
)
SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 12
            WHEN pizza_name = 'Vegetarian' THEN 10
        END
        + CASE 
            WHEN extras IS NOT NULL AND extras != '' THEN LENGTH(extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(extras, ',', '')) + 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_income
FROM order_pizzas o
JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE r.cancellation IS NULL OR r.cancellation = '';
